verification: Every YouTube record resolved live via YouTube oEmbed (title + author) on 2026-11-14; the NASA SVS visualization page returned HTTP 200 on 2026-11-14. Titles are the canonical oEmbed titles — never paraphrased.
note: Official NASA mission-media selection curated by the ZERO FLARE team. sourceType is labelled honestly: NASA-official channels are marked 'nasa-official'; university-lab and independent communicator/news uploads are marked as such and are NOT NASA footage provenance.

videos.title: Amazing Flame Comes to Life in Space Station Microgravity Combustion Science
videos.overview: NASA Johnson footage of droplet combustion science aboard the ISS — the experimental regime of the FLEX (PSI-69) and FLEX-2 (PSI-68) investigations: isolated methanol/heptane droplets burning spherically in microgravity.

videos.title: Hot Flame Aboard the International Space Station - July 14, 2021
videos.overview: NASA footage of a hot diffusion flame burning aboard the ISS — the gaseous-fuel regime studied by the ACME suite (Flame Design, s-Flame, CLD Flame, E-FIELD Flames, BRE) inside the Combustion Integrated Rack.

videos.title: Microgravity Combustion
videos.overview: University of Maryland Fire Protection Engineering footage of a spherical diffusion flame in microgravity — the burner geometry and buoyancy-free regime measured by ACME s-Flame (PSI-23). Institutional source, not NASA footage.

videos.title: Microgravity Combustion
videos.overview: NASA Connect educational segment on microgravity combustion research — why flames become spherical without buoyancy and what that changes for fire safety. Orientation context for the whole PSI corpus.

videos.title: ScienceCasts: Strange Flames on the International Space Station
videos.overview: NASA ScienceCasts episode on the 'strange' cool flames discovered in ISS droplet combustion — heptane droplets that re-ignite and burn cool after visible extinction, the phenomenon central to FLEX (PSI-69) and the Cool Flames Investigation (PSI-39, PSI-159).

videos.title: Solid Surface Combustion Experiment
videos.overview: NASA STI footage of the Solid Surface Combustion Experiment flown on the Space Shuttle — the flight-program ancestor of SAFFIRE's spacecraft fire-safety demonstrations and BASS solid-fuel studies.

videos.title: Combustion Integrated Rack (revised)
videos.overview: NASA Johnson overview of the Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) in the US Destiny laboratory — the facility that hosts ACME, FLEX, CFI/BASS follow-ons and SPICE. The hardware context for most recovered PSI tables.

videos.title: How Does Fire Behave In Space? | Video
videos.overview: Space.com (VideoFromSpace) explainer built around NASA's BASS solid-fuel burning experiments aboard the ISS — how flame spread over solid surfaces differs without buoyancy. Independent communicator source, not NASA footage.

videos.title: Saffire - Spacecraft Fire Experiment
videos.overview: SciNews coverage of the SAFFIRE spacecraft fire experiments on the Orbital ATK Cygnus cargo vehicle — large-scale flame spread tests impossible to run safely on the crewed station. Independent news source, not NASA footage.

videos.title: Saffire-I Experiment Burns in Space
videos.overview: NASA Video release of SAFFIRE-I — a large cotton-fiberglass sample burned deliberately inside an uncrewed Cygnus vehicle in 2016, returning the largest-scale microgravity flame-spread data recovered in this corpus (PSI-98).

videos.title: NASA's Spacecraft Fire Safety Demonstration Project, Saffire IV
videos.overview: NASA Glenn briefing on SAFFIRE-IV — the final SAFFIRE flight testing fire growth, detector response and suppression in a pressurized spacecraft module (PSI-100 in the recovered corpus).

videos.title: FLEX — NASA Scientific Visualization Studio
videos.overview: NASA Goddard SVS visualization page for the Flame Extinguishment Experiment: high-resolution renders and explainer material on droplet combustion and extinction on the ISS (PSI-69 / PSI-68). Opens on svs.gsfc.nasa.gov.

videos.title: Structure and Response of Spherical Diffusion Flames (s-Flame)
videos.overview: NASA Glenn research briefing on the s-Flame experiment: a spherical diffusion flame of gaseous fuel studied for soot formation and structure in microgravity — the direct subject of PSI-23's recovered experimental tables.
